description: Earnings-report disclosure window for one A-share: when the next periodic report is booked (`next_report`), whether today is its booked disclosure date (`discloses_today`), and the most recent report actually filed (`latest_disclosed`). Per-period `status`: scheduled | due_today | awaiting_confirmation (booked date passed, actual date not confirmed yet — T+1 lag or deferral, NOT a missed filing) | disclosed | unscheduled. Always read `coverage` first: schedule_pending means the exchange has not published the next period's calendar yet (released only ~5 days before period end) — a normal blackout, NOT 'this company does not report'; unknown means the name is absent from the calendar. T+1 data.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

periods.description: How many recent report periods to return (1-12, default 4)

name: calendar_reports
